# Local viewer dependencies

`trajectory.js` is an unmodified copy of ASSERT-KTH's trajectory-viewer parser, commit `0dc3c72159ea305eff942a8b6b937b6659782841`. It normalizes Claude Code session JSONL into Harbor-compatible ATIF, including split assistant messages, tool calls, and tool observations. The local viewer uses these paired arguments and results when reading saved Claude Code runs. Serving the parser directly keeps offline viewing independent of any CDN. [Upstream source](https://github.com/ASSERT-KTH/trajectory-viewer/blob/0dc3c72159ea305eff942a8b6b937b6659782841/trajectory.js) · [MIT license](trajectory-viewer.LICENSE) · [Harbor's ATIF specification](https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/blob/main/rfcs/0001-trajectory-format.md)

`eventsource-parser.js` is the browser ES module from `eventsource-parser@3.0.6` (commit `244d9f54e7fa728a6544a8996cf5f3740108cfdb`). The viewer uses it to read complete server-sent events, including multiline data and CR, LF or CRLF line endings. The package tarball is pinned by its npm SHA-512 integrity. The only edit to `dist/index.js` is removal of the final source-map directive because this distribution omits development source maps. The original module's SHA-256 is `333601532736aa39206e3c5529b458ee12e9bad38b93b43c24a1a8f28e0003ba`. [Published package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/eventsource-parser/v/3.0.6) · [Upstream source](https://github.com/rexxars/eventsource-parser/tree/244d9f54e7fa728a6544a8996cf5f3740108cfdb) · [MIT license](eventsource-parser.LICENSE)

The surrounding reader renders payload text as DOM text nodes. It does not resolve external links or media inside a trace.
